notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Anje.
You have at least one creature card with madness in hand.
You have at least one creature card with madness in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Anje by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card with madness.
Anje  triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card with madness from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
